description: This script automates the process of uploading a local build to Google Compute Engine and optionally launching a device. It includes functions to upload artifacts, launch, and stop a CVD (Cuttlefish Virtual Device), and a main function to parse command-line arguments and execute these actions.

methods.name: upload_artifacts
methods.description: Uploads image files and a host package to a remote device via SSH, using tar and gzip.

methods.name: launch_cvd
methods.description: Launches the Cuttlefish Virtual Device on the remote host via SSH.

methods.name: stop_cvd
methods.description: Stops the Cuttlefish Virtual Device on the remote host via SSH.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, stops any running CVD, uploads artifacts, and optionally launches a new CVD.
